{{Top|leg}}
The '''Burning Tu'kata''' was a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] gang that was active in the [[Nikto Sector]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Yeddu]] hired someone to sabotage the swoop bikes of the Burning Tu'kata and the [[Kintan Kings]] gang after [[Yeddu's brother|his brother]] was killed by the criminals.<ref name="One Fell Swoop">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|One Fell Swoop|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>
